roadmaps.title: Frontend Developer Roadmap
roadmaps.description: Master modern client-side engineering from HTML/CSS/JS fundamentals to React, API integration, and full production deployment.

sections.title: Section 1 — Web Fundamentals
sections.description: Understand how the internet, browsers, and client-server communication work.

sections.title: Section 2 — HTML
sections.description: Craft semantic, accessible, and SEO-friendly document structures.

topics.title: SEO Basics & Open Graph Meta Tags

sections.title: Section 3 — CSS
sections.description: Design captivating, responsive, and animated user interfaces.

sections.title: Section 4 — JavaScript
sections.description: Core logic, data structures, asynchronous programming, and DOM manipulation.

topics.title: Array Methods (map, filter, reduce, find, some)
ES6+ Modules, Optional Chaining & Nullish Coalescing

sections.title: Section 5 — Git and GitHub
sections.description: Version control workflows, branching strategies, and open-source collaboration.

sections.title: Section 6 — React
sections.description: Component-driven frontend architecture, lifecycle, hooks, and routing.

sections.title: Section 7 — Frontend and Backend Integration
sections.description: Connect client applications with RESTful services, manage async states, and auth tokens.

topics.title: HTTP Methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE)
Sending Form Data & File Uploads to Backend

sections.title: Section 8 — Projects
sections.description: Build end-to-end portfolio projects demonstrating industry-grade proficiency.

topics.title: Analytics Dashboard with Charts & Dark Mode
API-Based Live Weather / Movie Search App

sections.title: Section 9 — Deployment
sections.description: Ship optimized frontend builds to production hosting with CI/CD.

sections.title: Section 10 — Interview Preparation
sections.description: Master technical questions, live coding tasks, and placement interview rounds.

topics.title: JavaScript Tricky Closures, Hoisting & Event Loop Questions
React Hooks Lifecycle & State Batching Questions
Web Performance & Core Web Vitals Fundamentals
Basic DSA for Frontend (Strings, Arrays, Two-Pointer)
Frontend Machine Coding (Accordion, Autocomplete, Infinite Scroll)

sections.title: Section 5 — Databases (SQL & NoSQL)

sections.title: Section 6 — Security & Auth
sections.description: Securing web applications against top vulnerabilities.

sections.title: Section 7 — Backend Projects & Deployment
sections.description: Complete production-grade server projects and deployment.
